utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me more about what exactly needs fixing in the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I know Pia mentioned that people might overlap on the same jobs — what specific items are you thinking of bringing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm not sure yet what I'm bringing — I'm still trying to get a clear list of what's needed first. Do you have a list from someone?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, are you planning to join in on the repair drive too? I've got my tool kit ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm in — sorry I'm late, just trying to figure out what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries, Dane — I've got a list from Gus of the priority spots if you want to compare notes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Kira, don't forget the repair drive is next Saturday at the community center—everyone's bringing their busted tools to fix up together!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, next Saturday? I've heard different stories. Do you have any official notice or is this just word of mouth?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Well, I heard it from Rey and Bo, and I've been telling everyone—so it's pretty much set, next Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Faye! So glad I bumped into you — we're organizing a repair drive next Saturday at the community center, and I was hoping you could spread the word to your hiking group.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, actually I heard it got moved to Sunday — still at the community center, though.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Wait, are you sure it got moved? I hadn't heard that yet — let me double-check with Vik.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think it might be in the shed behind Bo's house now, but I'm not totally sure. Have you heard anything?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Actually, I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, not behind Bo's house.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, really? I must have been mistaken then. I saw someone carrying tools toward Bo's shed, but maybe it was something else.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... what's happening with it again?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday! We're collecting household items and tools to fix up the community center. Want to come?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: This Saturday, huh? Yeah, I could probably swing by—just remind me where we're dropping things off again?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, the Hendersons are running that repair drive. They're picking up donations this Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I'll bring my toolbox Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Leo. I'll see you there then. It's good to have people on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Pia, are you planning to pitch in for the repair drive this weekend? I heard they could use all the hands they can get!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might, but I'm worried about everyone stepping on each other's toes without a plan. Have you seen any schedule for who's fixing what?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I haven't seen a schedule yet, but I heard Eli's donating some old hammers—maybe we could start by sorting tools first!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, me too. Just trying to take it day by day.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Day by day is all we can do, right? I've been meaning to ask—did you check the shed yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rey, glad you're coming Saturday! I'll have the clock repair station set up near the front, so you can see the magic happen.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Mara. I'm curious to see how you fix that old clock.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I've been studying the mechanism all week, so I'm pretty confident we'll get it ticking again.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Nell, heard anything new about that repair drive? I've been asking around but no one seems to know when they're coming.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I've heard bits and pieces—Tess said Eli's donating old hammers, and Opal thinks the setup might be near the old oak tree by the park.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, near the old oak tree? That makes sense—it's central. Thanks for the update, Nell.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Gus! Just wanted to update you—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, thanks Rosa! That's good to know, I'll let Sam and Nell know about the change.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Gus! I appreciate you spreading the word. See you Sunday!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, glad you got it! See you there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: See you Sunday, Rosa! I'll make sure to bring my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, see you then!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I heard something about that—hope it gets sorted soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Right, you're not sure where it's at either? I'll have to check the shed then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sorry, I've been swamped—let me know what you find in the shed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Oren, I heard you might know more about the repair drive—are we all set for this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday, you say? Hmm, I thought it was Sunday. Are we sure about the time?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo mentioned Saturday to me, and I've been planning for that day. Are you thinking it might have changed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not yet, Ira. I'm still waiting to hear back from them. I'll let everyone know as soon as I get a date.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I saw Rosa earlier, she asked about starting Saturday morning. I told her I'd check with you first.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks for checking, Uli. I haven't heard back yet, but Saturday morning sounds like a good plan to me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm not sure—we should check the notice board; maybe there's a map posted there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good idea, Pia. I like having things clearly mapped out—let's go take a look.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's head over there now—I'd rather not risk any mix-ups with the supplies or the timing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'm helping with the repair drive Saturday. Need any tools from your garage, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think the drive might be at the shed behind Bo's house, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know, Opal. I'll check with Bo to confirm.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So it's at the community center at 10? I heard Eli's donating some hammers—sounds like it's really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's right! And I've been telling everyone—Hana even asked for a list of needed items, so I'm piecing one together. You should totally drop by!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A list sounds useful—what kind of stuff are you putting on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Ira, just a heads up—the repair drive was moved from this Saturday to Sunday at the community center, so we've got a little extra time to gather supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh good, Sunday works better for me anyway—thanks for the heads up, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Glad to hear it, Ira. Let me know if you need any particular tools—I've got a good stash of wrenches and screwdrivers set aside.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday, or are you just waiting to see if anyone else shows up first?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I'll definitely be there, and I'm planning to bring a few friends from the book club who are handy with tools!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That's great, the more hands the better. Are your friends bringing their own tools, or should we have extras on hand?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hana, I'm really looking forward to seeing you at the repair drive this Saturday. Don't forget to bring anything that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hold on — a repair drive this Saturday? I'm still trying to get the full picture; can you tell me what exactly we're supposed to be fixing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's a community event where we help each other fix broken household items. Just bring anything that's not working, and we'll try to repair it together!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I remember Mara saying something about it. But I'm a bit fuzzy on the time — do you know when it starts?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I'm not entirely sure about the exact time, but I think it's this weekend. Want me to check with Sam? She might know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, if you could check with Sam, that'd be great. I keep forgetting the details.
